title: spm: Scope Performance Metrics for Flutter rebuild scopes
description:
Unified static analysis and runtime profiling for Flutter rebuild scopes and their triggers.

spm analyze extracts per-scope static metrics of the widget tree a build method creates, spm inject and spm run measure profile-mode buildSpan on a device, and spm isolate writes self-contained copies of rebuild scopes. Version 0.8.0 adds spm screen, which compares two versions of a code base and gives two verdicts on the direction of each changed scope's rebuild cost: a count rule and a frozen random forest. The verdicts are a direction, never a build time. They come from measurements on one device and have not been evaluated with developers or in CI.
notes: Developed and maintained on GitHub as 32bytess (https://github.com/32bytess).
